Source-only dependency bundle for the Esparto ebuild of ZapFast 0.21.1.

Contains 813 registry crates from upstream's Cargo.lock, verified against their
original SHA-256 checksums. The bundle is generated reproducibly by GitHub Actions
and checked against the SHA-256 reviewed locally. This is not an application binary.

Pinned Git dependencies are fetched separately by the ebuild. Original source files
and their license files are included. See SHA256SUMS for the archive checksum.
